scope_completed: Layer 1 - authorization model: CopierLiveAuthorization + modify_authority / partial_close_authority / full_close_authority / close_only_after_expiry / correlation_id (migration 0012, additive, default-OFF). grant_copier_live_authorization extended with the matching --*-authority flags (default-OFF, fail-closed).

Layer 1 - flags: copier_live_modify_enabled / copier_live_partial_close_enabled / copier_live_full_close_enabled / copier_live_close_only_after_expiry_enabled / copier_live_contain_on_kill_switch_enabled (all DARK, ANDed with the LIVE arm stack).

Layer 2 - admission: admit_modify_live / admit_partial_close_live / admit_full_close_live (fail-closed; LINKED-ticket-only; no-exposure-increase; separate per-op authority; window + close-only-after-expiry + kill-switch containment policy; identity/pair/symbol/runtime gates mirrored from admit_open_live).

Layer 2 - typed command + job creation: create_live_modify_job (MODIFY_POSITION) / create_live_full_close_job (CLOSE_TRADE) / create_live_partial_close_job (PARTIAL_CLOSE_TRADE). Each re-locks the authorization + re-applies policy under the lock; carries operation id + follower binding + identity pin + master revision + authorization ref + correlation id + expiry/deadline + expected pre-state fingerprint + requested post-state; never consumes the entry allowance; never emits PLACE_ORDER.

Layer 2 - producer wiring: admit_close/admit_modify/admit_partial_close delegate a non-demo follower to the LIVE path; produce_close_one/produce_modify_one/produce_partial_close_one route a non-demo follower to create_live_*_job under the lock (mirrors admit_open/produce_one OPEN routing). The DEMO path is unchanged.

Runtime boundary (Amber): copier_live_lifecycle_authorized added to execution.live_authz and OR'd into bridge_config.allow_live_for_account (sets MT5_ALLOW_LIVE) ALONGSIDE the strict entry predicate. Fully DARK (returns False with every per-op arm OFF).
ADR-0083 written (lifecycle vocabulary reconciliation + transition table + authorization/containment policy + typed command contract + the two Amber decisions + deployment prerequisites).
scope_remaining: Layer 3 - operator failure-alert surfacing for the new MODIFICATION_FAILED / PARTIAL_CLOSE_FAILED / FULL_CLOSE_FAILED / DIVERGED / unknown-outcome reasons + a read-only operator view (which step failed, redacted identities, whether exposure exists / manual close required, no fabricated zero). Additive on the existing failure_alerts + operations summary.

Bridge-side enforcement of the expected-pre-state fingerprint and the typed-command deadline (the command carries them; the bridge today enforces the order-time identity pin + wrong-account-fails-closed). A separate reviewed bridge change before any live use.

Bounded unknown-broker-outcome retry executor (reconcile-before-retry; close-only bounded retries that reduce exposure). The detection/containment exists (close_failed -> CONTAINED_FAILURE, never auto-retried); the bounded executor is not armed.

The full ~80-scenario matrix + full 16-vector multi-agent adversarial review at production depth. A strong representative subset is covered (40 synthetic tests); the remainder is follow-up before any live arming.
safety_invariants_proved: NO-EXPOSURE-INCREASE: no lifecycle op creates a PLACE_ORDER/PLACE_ORDER_SHADOW (asserted); MODIFY carries no volume/side; PARTIAL strictly reduces (< current, rounded down, never full/below-min); FULL closes the bound ticket.
NO-LATE-ENTRY: lifecycle ops act only on a reconciled LINKED follower ticket; an unlinked/ambiguous ticket denies.
ENTRY-ALLOWANCE-UNTOUCHED: lifecycle ops never change orders_consumed (asserted).
SEPARATE AUTHORITY: each op requires its own default-OFF authority on the authorization.
CONTAINMENT: MODIFY never survives expiry or the kill switch; a close/partial-close contains only under the explicit, default-OFF close-only policies; no containment can increase/reopen exposure.
FAIL-CLOSED MID-FLIGHT: a revoke/expiry/kill-switch committed between admission and job creation yields no job.
DARK: with every per-op arm OFF (default) behaviour — incl. the MT5_ALLOW_LIVE posture — is unchanged.
limitations: Repository-only, DARK, default-OFF. No production deploy, no migration applied to prod, no flag armed, no broker order, no credential handled, no host/bridge contact, no Notion-authority lifecycle change.

No live readiness is claimed on synthetic tests. Promotion requires arming the per-op flags, granting the per-op authority, the bridge pre-state enforcement, and a Sponsor-present human-operated test.
The LIVE lifecycle path has never executed a real order; it is certified only against synthetic fakes.
Two files in the shared execution app (live_authz.py, bridge_config.py) are touched additively (the Amber runtime-boundary decision, documented in ADR-0083).
deployment_prerequisites: Separate Sponsor GO to merge (auto-merge OFF; STOP before merge).
A canonical deploy of main (production == main == e12a20c9 today; the new migration 0012 is additive).
Bridge-side pre-state/deadline enforcement reviewed + deployed before any live arming.

Gate parity for the live-bridge PROVISIONING renderer (live_bridge_provision.evaluate_live_gates) with the new lifecycle states (CONSUMED / expired-close-only / kill-switch-contained) — it currently fails CLOSED for them, so a lifecycle op cannot reach a live bridge end-to-end until this is addressed (no safety hole; recorded by the adversarial review).
Per-op flags armed + per-op authority granted + containment policy chosen, then a Sponsor-present live test.

adversarial_review.method: Two independent adversarial subagent lanes (exposure-safety; authority/identity/containment), each reading the diff + callees and running the suite. Findings verified dynamically.
invariants_confirmed_holding: No-exposure-increase / no PLACE_ORDER; no-late-entry (LINKED-ticket-only); entry-allowance untouched; partial-close rounds down + fail-closed; separate per-op authority; cross-tenant/identity gates; window + close-only containment both ways; kill-switch both ways; secret/PII (identity pin only, no credential).

findings.title: Lifecycle ops bound to the newest authorization for the pair, not the grant the position was opened under (both lanes found this).
findings.fix: Resolve the governing authorization from the OPEN's recorded copier_live_authorization_id (_governing_authorization); the preamble and the under-lock re-lock both bind to that exact id. Regression: test_regrant_does_not_widen_authority.

findings.title: No monotonic-sequence / superseded-by-close guard on the lifecycle path (a stale/out-of-order MODIFY could admit; two out-of-order SL changes could net-widen).
findings.fix: Added event.sequence > OPEN.sequence guard + _superseded_by_close for MODIFY/PARTIAL. Regressions: test_modify_superseded_by_later_close, test_lifecycle_event_must_be_after_open.

findings.title: Blank follower_symbol short-circuited the intent-symbol check and mislabelled the command symbol.
findings.fix: Unconditional require follower_symbol present AND == authz.follower_symbol (preamble + partial-close fresh read). Regression: test_blank_follower_symbol_denied.

findings.title: Cross-op idempotency gap (a FULL_CLOSE could be admitted while a PARTIAL_CLOSE was in flight on the same ticket, and vice versa).
findings.fix: _reducing_op_in_flight checks BOTH CLOSE_TRADE and PARTIAL_CLOSE_TRADE for every reducing/modify op. Regression: test_full_close_blocked_while_partial_in_flight.

findings.title: copier_live_lifecycle_authorized (the MT5_ALLOW_LIVE lifecycle boundary — the most security-sensitive change) had ZERO tests (evidence.md requires positive+negative controls).
findings.fix: Added RuntimeBoundaryTests: DARK-when-no-op-armed, authorized-when-armed, wrong-account, revoked, kill-switch-without/with-contain (6 positive/negative controls).

findings.title: The LIVE partial-close admission performs a bridge follower read under the replication/follower row lock.
findings.note: Inherited unchanged from the ADR-0055 demo partial-close path (execution_producer.produce_partial_close_one); ADR-0083 extends it to the LIVE path but does not introduce it. Restructuring the shared partial-close lock discipline is out of this packet's scope; recorded for a follow-up.

findings.title: The live-bridge provisioning path (live_bridge_provision.evaluate_live_gates) still requires status==ACTIVE + within-window + allowance-remaining + no-kill-switch, so it will NOT provision a live bridge for the new lifecycle states (CONSUMED / expired-close-only / kill-switch-contained).
findings.note: This FAILS CLOSED (no safety hole): the bridge will not go live for lifecycle states until the provisioning renderer is given gate parity. Recorded as a deployment prerequisite in ADR-0083; the lifecycle path cannot reach a live bridge end-to-end until then.

adversarial_review.result: All CRITICAL/HIGH fixed before PR-ready (1 HIGH + 1 MEDIUM + 2 LOW fixed; 1 MEDIUM test-gap closed). 1 LOW accepted as pre-existing; 1 fail-safe divergence documented as a deployment prerequisite. Full trade_copier suite re-run green at 738 tests after the fixes.

reviewer: Two independent adversarial subagent lanes + author disposition. 1 HIGH + 1 MEDIUM + 2 LOW fixed with mutation-killing regression tests; the untested runtime-boundary closed with 6 positive/negative controls; 1 LOW accepted (pre-existing ADR-0055) and 1 fail-safe divergence documented. No order placed, no credential handled, no production mutation.
